tldr: Moon through the 11th house brings focus to friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work.
body: Moon transiting the 11th house stirs friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work. For about two to three days, emotion, instinct, and immediate need move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a fast emotional transit: it shows what needs care today, not necessarily what needs to define the whole season.
business: Moon supports community contribution and future goals: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Mood-driven choices, insecurity, or belonging without discernment.
advice: Tend the feeling in the 11th house deliberately. Work with friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
